tools.name: action.batch
tools.description: File ▸ Automate ▸ Batch over every open document: play a saved action on each and write the results. Uses the open documents as the source, so it needs no file picker.

destDir.description: Absolute destination folder (native desktop only); omit to download each result instead.

format.description: Output format for each processed document.

template.description: File Naming template, e.g. "{name}_{serial}_processed"; empty uses the default.

tools.name: action.delete
tools.description: Delete a saved action.

tools.name: action.deleteStep
tools.description: Delete one step from an action.

tools.name: action.import
tools.description: Import actions from a .mvactions payload or an Adobe .atn pack. Steps whose command this build cannot replay are rejected (.mvactions) or imported as Stops naming them (.atn), never replaced with something else.

data.description: Vision's own mvactions JSON text, or — for format "atn" — the Adobe pack's bytes as base64.

tools.name: action.list
tools.description: List the saved actions as JSON (id, name, set, stepCount, favorite, lastPlayedAt).

query.description: Case-insensitive filter over action and set names; empty lists everything.

favoritesOnly.description: List only actions marked as favorites.

tools.name: action.moveStep
tools.description: Move a step within an action, which is how a recorded sequence is reordered.

fromIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step to move.

toIndex.description: Zero-based index to move it to.

tools.name: action.play
tools.description: Play a saved action on the active document, honoring disabled steps, stops and conditionals. Photoshop's Play / Play From Here.

fromStep.description: Zero-based step index to start from (Play From Here).

tools.name: action.record
tools.description: Begin or end recording. While recording, every command Photoshop would record becomes a step — MCP tools included, so an agent authors an action by running the tools it wants replayed. Photoshop's Begin/Stop Recording.

recording.description: True to begin a new recording (discarding an unsaved one), false to stop.

tools.name: action.rename
tools.description: Rename a saved action.

tools.name: action.runDroplet
tools.description: Run a droplet saved by File ▸ Automate ▸ Create Droplet over image files or folders, as dropping them on the droplet does: its action, File Naming, format and destination folder (Downloads when it has none). Native desktop only.

dropletPath.description: Absolute path of the droplet's .json descriptor (a droplet app keeps it at Contents/Resources/droplet.json).

paths.description: Absolute paths of the images or folders to process.

tools.name: action.save
tools.description: Save what was just recorded as a named action, so it shows up in the Actions panel and replays with action.play.

name.description: Name for the saved action; empty takes the next default ("Action 3").

tools.name: action.saveDroplet
tools.description: File ▸ Automate ▸ Create Droplet: save a saved action and Batch settings as a droplet. A path ending in .app builds a droplet app (macOS, signed for this Mac only) that runs when images or folders are dropped on it in Finder; any other path saves the .json descriptor. Native desktop only.

path.description: Absolute destination path ending in .app or .json.

format.description: Output format for each processed image.

template.description: File Naming template, e.g. "{name}_{serial}_processed"; empty uses the default.

destDir.description: Absolute folder the droplet writes to; omit to write to Downloads.

stopOnError.description: Stop at the first image that fails instead of logging it and going on.

tools.name: action.setStep
tools.description: Set a step's flags: whether it runs at all, and whether playback pauses on it to confirm. Photoshop's step checkbox and modal-dialog toggle.

enabled.description: False skips the step on playback.

dialog.description: True pauses playback on the step to confirm it.

tools.name: action.steps
tools.description: List an action's steps as JSON (index, label, args, enabled, dialog, volatile) — the indices every other step tool takes.

tools.name: adj.blackWhite
tools.description: Convert the active layer to black and white using Photoshop-style color-band mixing and optional tinting.

tint.description: Apply the selected tint to the grayscale result.

tools.name: adj.brightnessContrast
tools.description: Adjust brightness and contrast of the active layer.

tools.name: adj.cameraRawRecipe
tools.description: Apply or update a complete canonical Camera Raw recipe on the active layer. Smart Objects retain it as editable fid-17 data. Super Resolution is only supported while opening a RAW source and is rejected here.

recipeJson.description: JSON object matching the Camera Raw recipe schema, including optional profile, crop, healing, masks, and Enhance fields; enhance.superResolution must be false.

tools.name: adj.exposure
tools.description: Adjust exposure of the active layer.

tools.name: adj.hueSaturation
tools.description: Adjust hue, saturation and lightness of the active layer, optionally targeting six color ranges or colorizing the result.

hue.description: Hue shift in degrees, or the target hue while colorizing.

saturation.description: Saturation, or the target saturation while colorizing.

colorize.description: Map every pixel to the target hue and saturation.

ranges.description: Optional 18 numbers: hue, saturation, lightness triples for Reds, Yellows, Greens, Cyans, Blues, and Magentas. Hue values run from -180 to 180; saturation and lightness from -100 to 100.

tools.name: adj.invert
tools.description: Invert the colors of the active layer.

tools.name: adj.posterize
tools.description: Reduce the number of tonal levels (posterize) the active layer.

tools.name: adj.threshold
tools.description: Convert the active layer to high-contrast black and white at a threshold.

tools.name: adj.vibrance
tools.description: Boost less-saturated colors while protecting skin tones.

tools.name: brush.setSymmetry
tools.description: Select a Paint Symmetry preset. Changing presets resets its path to the document centre.

mode.description: Preset index: 0 Off, 1 Vertical, 2 Horizontal, 3 Dual Axis, 4 Diagonal, 5 Wavy, 6 Circle, 7 Spiral, 8 Parallel Lines, 9 Radial, 10 Mandala.

tools.name: brush.transformSymmetry
tools.description: Transform the active Paint Symmetry path in document coordinates.

tools.name: cameraRaw.loadProfile
tools.description: Load a DNG camera profile (.dcp) into Camera Raw's profile library, as Profile ▸ Load Profile… does. It is offered for RAWs from the camera it was made for (its UniqueCameraModel).

data.description: The DNG camera profile file's bytes, as base64.

name.description: The file name, used when the profile carries no ProfileName.

tools.name: cameraRaw.profiles
tools.description: List Camera Raw's DNG camera profile library and, when the workspace shows a RAW, the Profile menu for it: the built-in looks, its embedded profile and the library profiles made for its camera. Choose one by setting a recipe's profile to an entry's `profile` (with adj.cameraRawRecipe, or in the workspace).

tools.name: cameraRaw.selectSession
tools.description: Switch the open Camera Raw workspace to a pending session (filmstrip navigation).

sessionId.description: The session id to activate (from cameraRaw.sessions).

tools.name: cameraRaw.sessions
tools.description: List the pending Camera Raw sessions shown in the workspace filmstrip (active session first).

tools.name: cameraRaw.setImportOptions
tools.description: Set Camera Raw's RAW import options. Both persist as import preferences; a new demosaic also re-decodes the RAW the open Camera Raw workspace is showing.

demosaic.description: Mosaic (Bayer) demosaic: "adaptive" (PPG, edge-directed, fewer colour fringes) or "bilinear" (the fast 3×3 average). Omit to keep.

depth.description: Bits per channel of the document Open makes: 16, or 32 for a float document on the Image ▸ Mode ▸ 32 Bits scale that keeps highlights above white. Omit to keep.

tools.name: doc.addLayer
tools.description: Add a new empty layer above the active layer.

tools.name: doc.convertToProfile
tools.description: Edit ▸ Convert to Profile: convert the document into a built-in RGB profile (an RGB document), or separate it through the bundled working CMYK press profile (ISO Coated v2 300%, FOGRA39), which makes it a CMYK document whose plates come from that profile. 8/16-bit only for the CMYK destination.

blackPointCompensation.description: Map the source black point onto the destination's, keeping shadow detail. Defaults to Color Settings' Use Black Point Compensation.

dither.description: Dither the converted 8-bit values instead of rounding them (no effect on 16/32-bit documents).

tools.name: doc.exportAs
tools.description: Export the flattened composite to an absolute path using any flat format supported by File > Save As (JPEG 2000 is written lossless; Photoshop Raw interleaved, Mac byte order, no header). Leaves the document's own path and unsaved state untouched. Native desktop only.

path.description: Absolute destination path ending in a supported flat export format.

quality.description: JPEG quality; ignored by non-JPEG formats.

tools.name: doc.exportPngBase64
tools.description: Export the composited document as PNG image content for the MCP client.

tools.name: doc.loadDicomSeries
tools.description: File ▸ Scripts ▸ Load Multiple DICOM Files: open a DICOM series as one document with a layer per file, in Instance Number order. Native desktop only.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the DICOM files.

tools.name: doc.new
tools.description: Open a new tab with a blank document. Oversized requests are scaled to the engine's safe pixel budget. The reported name is the tab title after de-duplication.

width.description: Canvas width in the selected unit.

height.description: Canvas height in the selected unit.

name.description: Document name shown in the title.

resolutionPpi.description: Physical resolution in pixels per inch.

colorProfile.description: Built-in RGB color profile; ignored for non-RGB documents.

tools.name: doc.open
tools.description: Open an existing file from disk as a new document tab — the same loader File ▸ Open uses (PSD/PSB/XCF, RAW, PDF, SVG, JPEG 2000, Cineon/DPX, IFF, DICOM, .mvision, .monetgfx, .artisan and the common image formats). A headerless Photoshop Raw file needs doc.openPhotoshopRaw. Native desktop only.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to open.

tools.name: doc.openPhotoshopRaw
tools.description: Open a headerless Photoshop Raw file with the layout File ▸ Open's Photoshop Raw Options dialog asks for. Native desktop only.

path.description: Absolute path of the raw file.

interleaved.description: True when each pixel's channels are stored together; false for one channel plane after another.

header.description: Bytes to skip before the samples.

tools.name: doc.saveAs
tools.description: Save the active document to an absolute path, choosing the format from the extension (JPEG 2000 is written lossless; Photoshop Raw interleaved, Mac byte order, no header). Native desktop only.

path.description: Absolute destination path ending in a format supported by File > Save As.

tools.name: doc.setColorSettings
tools.description: Edit ▸ Color Settings: the Black Point Compensation default profile conversions start from, and the Advanced options. The two blend gammas change how layers composite (and so exports and Flatten); Desaturate Monitor Colors changes only the screen. Omitted options keep their current value.

blackPointCompensation.description: Use Black Point Compensation by default in Convert to Profile and the open/paste profile conversions.

desaturateMonitorColors.description: Desaturate Monitor Colors By this percent; 0 turns it off.

blendRgbGamma.description: Blend RGB Colors Using this gamma, between 1 and 3 (1 blends in linear light); 0 turns it off.

blendTextGamma.description: Blend Text Colors Using this gamma for type layers, between 1 and 3; 0 turns it off.

tools.name: fil.adaptiveWideAngle
tools.description: Correct lens barrel/perspective distortion on the active layer — pick a projection model, then optionally give constraint lines/polygons that must end up straight/rectangular. Photoshop's Adaptive Wide Angle filter.

model.description: Correction model; auto picks Fisheye or Perspective from focalLength/cropFactor.

focalLength.description: Focal length in mm, as engraved on the lens.

scale.description: Re-framing zoom applied after the correction; 1 = leave as corrected.

constraintsJson.description: JSON array of constraints, each `{kind:"line"|"polygon",pts:[number,number][]}` in normalizedimage coordinates; lines need 2 points, polygons need 4.

tools.name: fil.box
tools.description: Apply a box blur to the active layer.

tools.name: fil.gaussian
tools.description: Apply a Gaussian blur to the active layer.

tools.name: fil.median
tools.description: Apply a median filter (noise reduction) to the active layer.

tools.name: fil.removeDistractions
tools.description: Remove small high-contrast distractions from the active layer with local cleanup.

tools.name: fil.removeReflections
tools.description: Reduce bright reflection or glare streaks from the active layer with local cleanup.

split.description: Split into Underlying + Reflections layers (recompose to the original) instead of editing in place.

tools.name: fil.sharpen
tools.description: Sharpen the active layer.

tools.name: fil.sponge
tools.description: Apply the Artistic Sponge filter to the active layer.

tools.name: fil.unsharp
tools.description: Unsharp mask the active layer.

tools.name: layer.cleanup
tools.description: Delete empty layers and auto-name the layer stack.

tools.name: layer.editSmartObjectContents
tools.description: Layer ▸ Smart Objects ▸ Edit Contents: open the active Smart Object's contents as a new document tab. A Smart Object whose source is a Photoshop document (placed from a PSD/PSB, or embedded in an opened PSD/PSB) opens with its own layers; any other opens as its rendered pixels. Edit that tab, then call layer.updateSmartObjectContents.

tools.name: layer.updateSmartObjectContents
tools.description: Layer ▸ Smart Objects ▸ Update Edited Contents: send the active contents tab back into the Smart Object it was opened from. The Smart Object re-renders through its smart filters, and every instance of it updates.

tools.name: layer.vectorMaskFromPath
tools.description: Layer ▸ Vector Mask ▸ Current Path: clip the active layer to the Pen tool's current work path. Omit `op` to replace the mask outright (default); pass an op to fold the path into any existing vector mask instead.

op.description: Path operation folded into an existing vector mask: 0 Combine, 1 Subtract Front, 2 Intersect, 3 Exclude Overlapping. Omit to replace the mask.

tools.name: lens.apply
tools.description: Apply calibrated lens correction to the active layer as one undoable filter; Smart Objects retain an editable filter. Missing calibration fails without changing pixels.

profileId.description: Explicit catalog id; empty selects Automatic from this photo's metadata.

tools.name: lens.profiles
tools.description: Inspect the offline lens catalog and automatic/manual lookup for the active Camera Raw session or document. Missing matches include an actionable explanation.

query.description: Filter catalog names; empty returns the first 100 entries and the total count.

profileId.description: Explicit catalog id; empty selects Automatic.

tools.name: ml.aiDenoise
tools.description: Start an AI Denoise pass (DRUNet, tiled) over the document. Long-running: poll ml.jobStatus.

tools.name: ml.generateBackground
tools.description: Start a Generate Background pass: keep the subject, synthesize a new backdrop from the prompt. Long-running: poll ml.jobStatus.

prompt.description: Description of the new background scene.

tools.name: ml.generateImage
tools.description: Start a text-to-image generation, opening the result as a new document. Long-running: poll ml.jobStatus.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate.

tools.name: ml.generativeExpand
tools.description: Generative Expand: grow the canvas and synthesize the new border from surrounding content. Requires a licensed local MI-GAN model.

offsetX.description: Left offset of the original image in the new canvas.

offsetY.description: Top offset of the original image in the new canvas.

tools.name: ml.generativeFill
tools.description: Prompt-free Generative Fill of the current selection. Requires an active selection and a licensed local MI-GAN model.

tools.name: ml.generativeFillPrompt
tools.description: Start a prompted Generative Fill of the current selection (blended latent diffusion). Long-running: poll ml.jobStatus.

prompt.description: What to paint into the selection.

tools.name: ml.jobCancel
tools.description: Cancel a running long-lived ML job started through MCP. Poll ml.jobStatus until it reports cancelled.

jobId.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the job.

tools.name: ml.jobStatus
tools.description: Poll a long-running ML job started by a diffusion or denoise tool.

jobId.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the job.

tools.name: ml.models
tools.description: Report on-device ML weight availability per feature: which model files are present and whether each feature is ready.

tools.name: ml.removeBackground
tools.description: Isolate the main subject onto a new transparent layer (U²-Net alpha matte).

tools.name: ml.selectSubject
tools.description: Select the main subject via U²-Net and load it as the active selection.

tools.name: ml.skinSmoothing
tools.description: Skin Smoothing (Featured Neural Filter): soften skin texture while keeping eyes, lips and hair detail. Skin-tone chroma gate, restricted to detected faces when the face-landmark model is installed.

tools.name: ml.styleTransfer
tools.description: Apply a neural style-transfer network to the active document, stamping the result on a new layer.

tools.name: ml.superResolution
tools.description: Upscale the document 3× with the ESPCN super-resolution network, opening the result as a new document.

tools.name: print.oneCopy
tools.description: File ▸ Print One Copy: print the document with the saved File ▸ Print… settings, without the Print dialog. The OS print dialog still opens.

tools.name: print.setSettings
tools.description: File ▸ Print… settings, which Print One Copy (print.oneCopy) prints with: media and orientation, position, scale and Color Management. Omitted options keep their saved value; invalid ones are refused and nothing is saved. Returns the resulting layout.

center.description: Center the image on the media; false places it at top/left.

top.description: Inches from the page's top edge to the image, when not centered.

left.description: Inches from the page's left edge to the image, when not centered.

scaleToFit.description: Scale to Fit Media; false prints at scale.

scale.description: Percent of the document's print size, its pixels at its ppi.

colorHandling.description: photoshop converts through the printer profile before spooling; printer sends the document's own tagged pixels.

printerProfile.description: The bundled working CMYK press profile, or the one last loaded in the Print dialog.

intent.description: Rendering intent of the printer-profile conversion.

blackPointCompensation.description: Black Point Compensation for the printer-profile conversion.

matchPrintColors.description: Soft-proof the Print dialog preview through the printer profile.

showPaperWhite.description: Simulate the paper white in the Match Print Colors preview.

tools.name: script.run
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the sandboxed scripting console — the whole recorded command surface as `vision.*` ops plus `await vision.read.*` queries, with the console's op budget and timeouts. Use `vision.log(…)` to return values.

code.description: JavaScript source to execute against the `vision` scripting API.

tools.name: shortcuts.deleteSet
tools.description: Delete a saved set; deleting the active, unmodified set restores Monet Defaults.

name.description: Saved set name; Monet Defaults cannot be deleted.

tools.name: shortcuts.exportSet
tools.description: Export a shortcut set as portable .monetkeys JSON. Omit name to export current shortcuts, including workspace overrides.

name.description: Saved set name, Monet Defaults, or empty for current shortcuts.

tools.name: shortcuts.importSet
tools.description: Import and activate a validated Monet .monetkeys JSON file, preserving other saved sets.

replace.description: Explicitly replace an existing set with the imported name.

tools.name: shortcuts.listSets
tools.description: List Monet Defaults, saved shortcut sets, and the current effective overrides.

tools.name: shortcuts.saveSet
tools.description: Save current shortcuts as a named set. Monet Defaults cannot be overwritten.

name.description: Name for the saved set (1–80 characters).

replace.description: Explicitly replace an existing set with this name.

tools.name: shortcuts.selectSet
tools.description: Activate a saved shortcut set or Monet Defaults and persist its bindings.

name.description: Saved set name, or Monet Defaults.

tools.name: view.collapseDock
tools.description: Collapse a dock to panel icons or restore its expanded panels. Saved workspace layouts retain this setting.

collapsed.description: True for the icon rail; false for expanded panels.

tools.name: view.floatWindows
tools.description: Window ▸ Arrange: float documents out of the tab bar into their own windows, cascade those windows, or consolidate every document back into tabs. Desktop app only. Returns the floated document ids.

action.description: float: the active document; floatAll: every open document; cascade: float every document and line the windows up diagonally; consolidate: all back into tabs.

tools.name: view.scope
tools.description: Summarize a scope's live density grid as JSON stats (dimensions + occupancy), without returning the raw grid.

kind.description: Which scope to sample: vectorscope, waveform, or waveform-rgb (default vectorscope).

tools.name: view.setPanelOptions
tools.description: Change a panel's thumbnail size or the Swatches grid/list view, using the same persisted options as its flyout menu.

thumbnailSize.description: Thumbnail size: Layers 24/40/64, Channels 26/40/64, Swatches 16/24/40 pixels.

swatchView.description: Swatches preset view; ignored for other panels, and kept as it is when omitted.

tools.name: view.setProof
tools.description: Set a proof setup mode and enable Proof Colors.

mode.description: Proof mode id such as cmyk, acescg, aces2065, hdr-pq, or hdr-hlg.

bpc.description: Black Point Compensation for the CMYK proof LUT (default on, matching Photoshop).

tools.name: view.setScope
tools.description: Set the Histogram panel scope mode.

mode.description: Scope mode: histogram, vectorscope, waveform, waveform-rgb, or waveform-parade.

tools.name: xform.crop
tools.description: Crop the document to a rectangle.

tools.name: xform.flipHorizontal
tools.description: Flip the canvas horizontally.

tools.name: xform.flipVertical
tools.description: Flip the canvas vertically.

tools.name: xform.resizeImage
tools.description: Resize the whole image (resamples all layers).

tools.name: xform.rotate180
tools.description: Rotate the canvas 180 degrees.

tools.name: xform.rotate90
tools.description: Rotate the canvas 90 degrees.

clockwise.description: Rotate clockwise when true, counter-clockwise when false.
